title: M6 front page

fields.label: Show chapter
fields.name: hero_show
fields.instructions: Turn off to hide this chapter (the chapter rail skips it too).

fields.label: Name in the chapter rail
fields.name: hero_nav
fields.instructions: One or two words.

fields.label: Anchor ID
fields.name: hero_anchor
fields.instructions: A link "#top" scrolls here. Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: hero_title
fields.instructions: The only main heading of the page (h1). One line per line of the heading.

fields.label: Lead
fields.name: hero_lead
fields.instructions: One or two sentences under the heading.

fields.label: Button label
fields.name: hero_cta_label
fields.instructions: The button scrolls to the V10 chapter. Name the action.

fields.label: Car, desktop
fields.name: hero_image
fields.instructions: Cut-out car on a transparent background (PNG or WebP), at least 2560 px wide. It stands on the studio backdrop.

fields.label: Car, phone
fields.name: hero_image_mobile
fields.instructions: Optional. A cut-out framed for a tall phone screen. If empty, the desktop image is used.

fields.label: Show chapter
fields.name: profile_show
fields.instructions: Turn off to hide this chapter (the chapter rail skips it too).

fields.label: Name in the chapter rail
fields.name: profile_nav
fields.instructions: One or two words.

fields.label: Anchor ID
fields.name: profile_anchor
fields.instructions: A link "#profile" scrolls here. Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only.

fields.label: Side profile
fields.name: profile_image
fields.instructions: Cut-out car seen exactly from the side, transparent background, at least 2560 px wide.

fields.label: Studio behind the side profile
fields.name: profile_backdrop
fields.instructions: Optional. The same photo as the side profile, whole (not cut out), in the same frame: the studio and the floor under the car. The badge stands between the two.

fields.label: Big badge behind the car
fields.name: profile_ghost
fields.instructions: Decorative, not read aloud; set in the BMW M badge manner with the three M stripes. For example "M6".

fields.label: Figures
fields.name: profile_figures
fields.instructions: Three or four true numbers. Value without the unit.

fields.label: Show chapter
fields.name: design_show
fields.instructions: Turn off to hide this chapter (the chapter rail skips it too).

fields.label: Name in the chapter rail
fields.name: design_nav
fields.instructions: One or two words.

fields.label: Anchor ID
fields.name: design_anchor
fields.instructions: A link "#design" scrolls here. Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: design_title
fields.instructions: One line per line of the heading (press Enter for a new line). Short: 2–4 words per line.

fields.label: Lead
fields.name: design_lead
fields.instructions: One or two sentences.

fields.label: Car
fields.name: design_image
fields.instructions: Cut-out car, three-quarter view, transparent background, at least 2560 px wide. The hotspots sit on this picture.

fields.label: Hotspots
fields.name: design_hotspots
fields.instructions: Points on the car. X and Y are the position on the picture in % (0 = left / top, 100 = right / bottom). Open the page to check where a point lands.

sub_fields.label: Label
sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.instructions: Shown next to the point, 1–3 words.

fields.label: Show chapter
fields.name: power_show
fields.instructions: Turn off to hide this chapter (the chapter rail skips it too).

fields.label: Name in the chapter rail
fields.name: power_nav
fields.instructions: One or two words.

fields.label: Anchor ID
fields.name: power_anchor
fields.instructions: A link "#power" scrolls here. Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: power_title
fields.instructions: One line per line of the heading (press Enter for a new line). Short: 2–4 words per line.

fields.label: Lead
fields.name: power_lead
fields.instructions: Two or three sentences about the engine.

fields.label: Engine photo
fields.name: power_image
fields.instructions: Landscape, at least 2000 px wide. The sound button sits on it, bottom left.

fields.label: Engine facts
fields.name: power_specs
fields.instructions: Short facts in one line under the engine photo.

fields.label: Sound button label
fields.name: power_button_label
fields.instructions: The button on the engine photo plays the recording.

fields.label: Sound button note
fields.name: power_hint
fields.instructions: Small line under the button label.
fields.default_value: Full throttle in a tunnel. Sound on.

fields.label: Show chapter
fields.name: drive_show
fields.instructions: Turn off to hide this chapter (the chapter rail skips it too).

fields.label: Name in the chapter rail
fields.name: drive_nav
fields.instructions: One or two words.

fields.label: Anchor ID
fields.name: drive_anchor
fields.instructions: A link "#drive" scrolls here. Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: drive_title
fields.instructions: One line per line of the heading (press Enter for a new line). Short: 2–4 words per line.

fields.label: Text
fields.name: drive_text
fields.instructions: Two or three sentences. A blank line starts a new paragraph.

fields.label: Photos
fields.name: drive_photos
fields.instructions: Three or four photos for the collage. The first one is the biggest.

sub_fields.label: Photo
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: At least 1600 px on the long side.

fields.label: Show chapter
fields.name: film_show
fields.instructions: Turn off to hide this chapter (the chapter rail skips it too).

fields.label: Name in the chapter rail
fields.name: film_nav
fields.instructions: One or two words.

fields.label: Anchor ID
fields.name: film_anchor
fields.instructions: A link "#film" scrolls here. Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: film_title
fields.instructions: One line per line of the heading (press Enter for a new line). Short: 2–4 words per line.

fields.label: Lead
fields.name: film_lead
fields.instructions: Optional. One or two sentences next to the heading.

fields.label: Film, desktop
fields.name: film_video
fields.instructions: A short muted loop (10–20 s), MP4 (H.264), panoramic 20:9, 1920 px wide, under 6 MB. It plays only while on screen. The chapter is skipped while this is empty.

fields.label: Film, phone
fields.name: film_video_mobile
fields.instructions: Optional. The same loop at 960 px wide for phones.

fields.label: Poster
fields.name: film_poster
fields.instructions: A still from the film, the same frame (20:9). Shown before the film loads.

fields.label: Film description
fields.name: film_label
fields.instructions: Read by screen readers, for example "The M6 driving on a motorway at dusk".

fields.label: Caption
fields.name: film_caption
fields.instructions: Optional. Small line under the film, for example the credit for the footage.

fields.label: Show chapter
fields.name: specs_show
fields.instructions: Turn off to hide this chapter (the chapter rail skips it too).

fields.label: Name in the chapter rail
fields.name: specs_nav
fields.instructions: One or two words.

fields.label: Anchor ID
fields.name: specs_anchor
fields.instructions: A link "#specs" scrolls here. Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: specs_title
fields.instructions: One line per line of the heading (press Enter for a new line). Short: 2–4 words per line.

fields.label: Tabs
fields.name: specs_tabs
fields.instructions: One tab per group: Engine, Gearbox, Chassis, Dimensions.

sub_fields.label: Value
sub_fields.name: value
sub_fields.instructions: With the unit, for example "520 Nm at 6,100 rpm".

fields.name: heritage_show

fields.label: Name in the chapter rail

fields.instructions: One or two words.

fields.label: Anchor ID
fields.name: heritage_anchor
fields.instructions: A link "#heritage" scrolls here. Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: heritage_title
fields.instructions: One line per line of the heading (press Enter for a new line). Short: 2–4 words per line.

fields.label: Text
fields.name: heritage_text
fields.instructions: Two or three sentences.

fields.label: Then: photo
fields.name: heritage_then_image
fields.instructions: The ancestor, shown in black and white.

fields.label: Then: caption
fields.name: heritage_then_caption
fields.instructions: For example "M635CSi, 1983".

fields.label: Now: photo
fields.name: heritage_now_image
fields.instructions: Optional. If empty, the hero car is used.

fields.label: Now: caption
fields.name: heritage_now_caption
fields.instructions: For example "M6, 2005".

fields.label: Show chapter
fields.name: outro_show
fields.instructions: Turn off to hide this chapter (the chapter rail skips it too).

fields.label: Name in the chapter rail
fields.name: outro_nav
fields.instructions: One or two words.

fields.label: Anchor ID
fields.name: outro_anchor
fields.instructions: A link "#contact" scrolls here. Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: outro_title
fields.instructions: Big closing heading. One line per line; the lines are set in steps.

fields.label: Text
fields.name: outro_text
fields.instructions: One or two sentences about who built this page.

fields.label: Closing photo
fields.name: outro_image
fields.instructions: Optional. A dark studio shot, landscape 16:9, at least 2560 px wide. It runs edge to edge under the heading.

fields.label: Button label
fields.name: outro_cta_label
fields.instructions: Links to the developer link from M6 Settings.

description: Every chapter of the M6 page (docs/CONTENT-MODEL.md).
